summary: Defines the Host Resources MIB for managing host computers, covering things such as storage, processes and installed software. It clarifies the earlier version based on implementation experience and moves to the SMIv2 format. It is a standards-track document at the draft standard level.

eli5.summary: This lets management software ask a computer what it has inside, like disk space and running programs.
